event_name: NHRA Potomac Nationals presented by JEGS

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 76 degrees, relative humidity 32 percent, barometer 29.99 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,394 feet. 

Smith is 7 - 1 against Oehler in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other in a final
round.

Smith with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  She wins her first Wally this season
and fourth of here career.  Smith make the quickest pass of the event for the win.


Oehler with another great pass in the losing effort.
